Rule Description: Every scheduler is capable of issuing one instruction per cycle, but for this kernel each scheduler only issues an instruction every 2.5 cycles. Every cycle with no eligible warp results in no instruction being issued and the issue slot remains unused. Reducing stalls indicated on the Warp State Statistics and Source Counters sections can help, too.
